policy: Launch planning is advisory and company-scoped. Automatic gates may read known marketplace/workforce coverage and evidence, but manual business, training, compliance, pilot and job-completion gates require explicit company confirmation. No launch-plan state grants authority, publishes a service, purchases products or executes work.

stages.name: Opportunity detected
stages.description: At least one matching company growth signal exists.

stages.name: Capability review
stages.description: Titan has compared the service against known Marketplace and Workforce coverage.

stages.name: Prerequisites ready
stages.description: Known required Marketplace products and Workforce specialists are covered.

stages.name: Training & compliance ready
stages.description: Required service-specific training/compliance checks have been explicitly confirmed.

stages.name: Pilot ready
stages.description: Pilot scope, QA method and operating process have been confirmed.

stages.name: Ready to sell
stages.description: Coverage, compliance/training, quote/scope and delivery standards are confirmed. This is planning readiness only; it does not publish or sell anything.

stages.name: First job scheduled
stages.description: A first-job reference has been explicitly recorded.

stages.name: First job completed
stages.description: The company has explicitly confirmed completion of the first job.

commercial.label: Commercial QA and inspection standard confirmed

airbnb.label: Turnover timing and reset standard confirmed

healthcare.label: Applicable healthcare cleaning requirements reviewed for this jurisdiction

education.label: Applicable school/childcare cleaning requirements reviewed for this jurisdiction

food.label: Applicable food-premises cleaning requirements reviewed for this jurisdiction
